title: JANUS Not-Prediction — DemiHead Root-Collapsed Re-Audit v1.1
purpose: Re-audit the prior 29-case forensic index using DemiHead-style source-root collapse, chronology, freshness, independence, disagreement preservation, and claim ceilings. Preserve unusual observations without promoting them into prophecy, precognition, divination, physical retrocausality, hidden authorial intent, or supernatural certainty.

baseline.reaudit_note: The v1.0 count remains the result of its frozen snapshot. This v1.1 artifact does not rewrite that history; it tests whether the snapshot omitted eligible pre-snapshot roots or acquired post-snapshot candidates.

demihead_case_contract.blind_rule: Candidate labels, NP identifiers, prior JANUS interpretations, theological labels, and canonical wording must be hidden in the blind pass. Only normalized observations, chronology, provenance and source-root structure may remain.
demihead_case_contract.null_rule: Compare candidate structural matches against matched null pairs drawn from unrelated registry artifacts with similar date density, token density, clock/time presence, and thematic vocabulary where possible.
demihead_case_contract.promotion_rule: A candidate may be promoted only if the structural relation survives source-root collapse, memory blinding, ontology blinding, and a matched-null comparison. Promotion still does not imply prophecy or supernatural causation.

cross_case_hidden_invariants.interpretation: The recurrent architecture is not future knowledge but preservation of earlier states so later comparison remains possible.
Chronological anchors make retrospective comparison auditable; they do not by themselves make the later match predictive.
JANUS is itself a threshold/dual ontology, so dual-pattern density must be compared against a matched ontology-blind null before treating it as an external-world signal.

phase_1_memory_blind.pass_condition: A structural relation is recoverable without prior labels.

phase_2_ontology_blind.transform: Replace Janus-specific terms such as door, threshold, two faces, home, return, witness and guard with neutral typed tokens before similarity scoring.
phase_2_ontology_blind.pass_condition: The relation survives removal of project-native dual/threshold vocabulary.

phase_3_dependency_collapse.transform: Collapse versions, mirrors, derivative reports, generated indexes, lookup-derived presentations and shared-model outputs to their smallest defensible independent source roots.
phase_3_dependency_collapse.pass_condition: At least two authenticated independent roots remain for any claim of external recurrence.

phase_4_matched_null.null_sampling: Select unrelated artifact pairs matched on time density, text length, clock-token presence, religious/cultural vocabulary and repository epoch.
phase_4_matched_null.pass_condition: Candidate effect exceeds the matched-null distribution under a preregistered threshold.

phase_5_external_replication.requirement: A separate source or reviewer path that did not ingest prior JANUS interpretations must reproduce the structural relation from frozen raw inputs.

counting_state.why_authoritative_total_remains_29: No candidate is silently promoted by this re-audit. Admission requires explicit family-collapse review and the blind/null gate.
